item.title: Criterion Channel’s December Lineup: Olivier Assayas, Jean-Pierre Melville, Holiday Classics, ‘Unzipped’ & More
item.description: The Criterion Channel closes out 2026 with an impressive mix of holiday favorites, international auteur cinema, newly restored classics, and a few unexpected additions. December’s programming includes major retrospectives devoted to Olivier Assayas , Jean-Pierre Melville , John Schlesinger , and Margarethe von Trotta , alongside Christmas-themed collections, a celebration of Federico Fellini , and the exclusive streaming premiere of the fashion documentary “ Unzipped .” There’s also a pair of beloved Jim Henson fantasies, a spotlight on Japanese filmmaker Sho Miyake , and all 52 episodes of the original “ Speed Racer ” anime series.
